info.title: Wenxu API v2 - Incremental Design Draft
info.description: Design only, not implemented. Contains 26 new operations and 7 updated existing contracts. All 17 management writes require an actor-scoped Idempotency-Key and atomically committed durable success receipt. Unchanged authentication, start/preview/submit, responses and legacy survey statistics remain documented in 03_API说明.md. See 08_新版接口设计.md for permission, concurrency, normalization, durable replay and error-code semantics.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: false on first completion; true when replaying the stored original success. Replayed bodies are historical, not current resource state.

409.description: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED / IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS, REVISION_CONFLICT, archive, legacy structure, survey state, or unsupported values conflict.

Retry-After.description: Present for in-progress or temporarily unconfirmed results. Retry the same key and original payload after this many seconds.

422.description: INVALID_REQUEST or a documented domain validation error.

503.description: DATABASE_ERROR, IDEMPOTENCY_RESULT_UNKNOWN, or IDEMPOTENCY_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE. Preserve the original key and payload; absence of a visible receipt does not prove rollback.

Retry-After.description: Present for in-progress or temporarily unconfirmed results. Retry the same key and original payload after this many seconds.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Generate once per logical operation, not per click or fetch. Scoped by authenticated actor; reuse on retries with the original operation, target, body and query revision.

post.description: Requires Idempotency-Key. After authentication and pure input validation, replay a matching actor-scoped success receipt before checking current revision, source permissions or resource state. A reused key with different normalized operation/target/body/query is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. The key reservation, business mutation, response snapshot and success receipt commit in one transaction. Concurrent retries cannot execute the business mutation twice; retry unknown outcomes with the original key. Success replay preserves the original status and JSON body, and never reactivates or recreates a subsequently changed/deleted resource.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Generate once per logical operation, not per click or fetch. Scoped by authenticated actor; reuse on retries with the original operation, target, body and query revision.

patch.description:
A persisted identical (id, questionId, versionId) keeps its server snapshot after revocation. New or changed bindings recheck source access. Legacy questions updates return 409 LEGACY_SURVEY_REQUIRES_MIGRATION.

Requires Idempotency-Key. After authentication and pure input validation, replay a matching actor-scoped success receipt before checking current revision, source permissions or resource state. A reused key with different normalized operation/target/body/query is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. The key reservation, business mutation, response snapshot and success receipt commit in one transaction. Concurrent retries cannot execute the business mutation twice; retry unknown outcomes with the original key. Success replay preserves the original status and JSON body, and never reactivates or recreates a subsequently changed/deleted resource.

post.summary: Publish a saved draft without reauthorizing preserved references

Idempotency-Replayed.description: false on first completion; true when replaying the stored original success. Replayed bodies are historical, not current resource state.

get.description: Login is required. No library question/version IDs, version number, ownership, origin, permissions, internal revisions, or jump rules are exposed.

IdempotencyKey.description: One lowercase UUID v4 per actor-scoped logical management operation. Reuse the original key and original parameters after an unknown result.

DateTime.description: Timezone required; UTC millisecond precision in responses.

Numeric.description: Finite JSON number; integer precision is checked by the application.
